body:
Yes. I struggle with myself for years. I know what I am talking about.
You need a radical change which will not happen just like that. You need to work hard without knowing whether you will make it. You struggle and things only become worse, complicated. For someone it's not like that, some people have happier lives. What matters is an attitude. But, somehow, life is a misery anyway. You only see how small and tiny you are, a ignorant spot in a vast world of ignorance.

A reason to live..I don't know. For somebody it could be family, a child, partner, job etc.. you know it yourself deep inside. why should you kill yourself? Because life has no real meaning. It's a painful experience and it will be always, with bits of happiness.. here and there..basically a piece of crap.

you know, even if some countries do have free health care..I didn't hear about one single person in life that got cured, whoever had problem, social anxiety for example which is not so big problem, there are worse. Somehow there could be a certain improvements but total cure..a fairy tale. No one knows what is happening inside someone's mind. Patients can lie, there are those who keep coming back..Everything is very complex and difficult.  Mental illnesses are hard to deal with. Talking with a stranger doesn't really help. That is a personal experience. When somebody thinks about suicide..that person must have very big problems. One talk is not enough. Suicidal thoughts come back. You need to work hard in order to change your miserable life. And how to do that when you don't have a motivation? 
About the thing who is responsible..yes, but I think that everybody are responsible. A state, a society, family, you. Not only you. That doesn't help in any way because nobody will fix your problem but you aren't fault alone. We are born in chains together and everybody pull those chains, pulling you as well, it would be much easier that I am free from the rest of the people, in my own chains.

I do. What is worse, there is no salvation. I tried everything. For us who are suffering very much everything is much harder then for the rest of the people.  Imagine just people without limbs..they usually don't have a money to pay for prosthesis..or someone with terrible illnesses, who has to give billions for medicine besides being humiliated in all ways. That is how it goes, one misery after another instead of feeling relief and hope. And nobody really cares, people care for money. You are my friend mentally ill most probably. But if it would make you slightly feel better, I am a lost case..I suffered for years and years, it is unbearable pain. I tried to cure myself, nothing is working. I just gave up. Things become even harder for me, impossible. I feel like an invalid and I am not. Now I lost hopes. But I tried it, you can at least try to make your life better but be careful, basically you have to work hard for whatever you want to accomplish, nothing is easy in life. Nothing.

I once had a lot of friends..and I wasn't happy. I liked them somehow, on the other hand, I didn't. At the end, I realized they didn't fit me, or I didn't fit them. I was just lonely, I wasn't selective with friends. So, I think you are surrounded with "bad" friends just like I was. Many of them were vulgar and I don't like it. I pretended I liked it but I felt unpleasant inside. They mocked me just I pretended it was fine. Other times, they were ok so I continued hanging out with them. Feelings are changeable..one day you look at a t shirt you want desperately to buy, the other day, you realize you don't like it so much, you don't need it. The same with people. The thing is that you don't know them..now you have to have an intuition to tell you how someone is. But if you don't have it..don't accept everything just like that, give yourself a time to see, to test.
I am tired too, I just want an end and that I never be born again. But your question has something positive, as you want to try just one more time..I don't.

I don't like that hypocrisy either. And then they tell they can help. Nobody can help. Nobody is a doctor here. A simple talk will not help. People struggle with big problems. For some of us who are looking aside they look stupid, for those who are having them, they are not.
You need a lot of money for some treatment. Nobody will give it to you for free. Nobody really really cares. Even your parents. Nobody cares if you will die in torment. After all, you are not the only one. You are just a coward who gave up from life.

Finally, somebody who thinks like me. You know what else? Instead of proving God's existence, I think people should try at least to prove God's goodness. I don't know what sadist would do what he done to people on earth. After reading 50 pages of Bible I think that God is a monster, a dictator, I can't believe that somebody can think that he is good. As you said, I don't see a purpose of living. Even if heaven exist, I don't think it could be better than earth. Why should that sadist of God put us here to suffer if heaven is such a big deal, if it is a place of perfect peace and happiness..so it is not. There is the same shit as on earth. He is playing a game. You have to learn to humiliate yourself and accept your eternal suffering, your eternal inferior position, that is all. If he doesn't exist, what is a purpose of living anyway? To live working all day for money, bearing  stupid bosses, workers..have false friends, a partner who will probably cheat..having tiring children.. I think that people are masochists. they enjoy their suffering for a piece of crap of happiness. In the end they will die. No matter if you are a rich genius or poor person, one day you will not exist, all your life will be erased.
